description: Source code for the Contacts module in a CRM system, defining the Contacts class with methods for retrieving related records such as opportunities, activities, tickets, quotes, and history.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Represents the Contacts entity in the CRM, with methods to retrieve related records and manage contact data.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Represents the Contacts entity in the CRM, with methods to retrieve related records, manage attachments, transfer related records, generate report queries, handle dependencies, and send portal emails.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of contacts assigned to a specific user.

methods.name: get_contacts1
methods.description: Retrieves contact details for a user with a specific email address (may be unused).

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts for a user with pagination (may be unused).

methods.name: process_list_query1
methods.description: Processes a query to return a list of contacts in array format.

methods.name: plugin_process_list_query
methods.description: Processes a query with security parameters to return a filtered list of contacts.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves opportunities related to a contact.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities (tasks, events) related to a contact.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves historical activities (completed, deferred, held) related to a contact.

methods.name: get_tickets
methods.description: Retrieves tickets related to a contact.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes related to a contact.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes related to a contact, with query involving vtiger_quotes and related tables.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Retrieves related SalesOrder records for a contact.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves related Products for a contact.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Retrieves related PurchaseOrder records for a contact.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Returns a list of emails related to a contact.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Returns campaigns associated with a contact.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Returns invoices related to a contact.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs SQL query to export contact records in CSV format based on a where condition.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves column names for the Contacts table, used by Word plugin.

methods.name: get_searchbyemailid
methods.description: Returns query to find contacts by email address, used by Outlook plugin.

methods.name: get_contactsforol
methods.description: Returns query to get contacts assigned to a user, used by Outlook plugin.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles module-specific operations when saving an entity.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads and saves file attachments related to a contact or other entity.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Moves related records from specified entity IDs to a target record, updating relation tables accordingly.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Constructs a secondary query part for reports involving related contact details and associated tables.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table information for related modules based on the secondary module name.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks and marks as deleted all dependent entities related to a contact, including potentials, tickets, orders, quotes, and portal info.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes a specific relationship between a contact and another entity/module.

methods.name: getPortalEmailContents
methods.description: Generates email content for portal users, including login details and support notifications.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Associates related modules and records with a contact, inserting into relation tables.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Returns available list action buttons based on user permissions.
